description:
explain_finding({"gap_id":"rls_disabled"})
Use after a check returns a finding id, such as rls_disabled or env_var_drift, to understand and fix that VibeRaven 1.7.8 finding. Returns detection scope, impact, fix guidance and coverage limits quoted from viberaven.dev with source links. Unknown ids return found: false and known ids. For a raw error without a finding id, use search_guides.
Limits: explains published rules only; does not read your repo, database or Vercel project.

gap_id.description: The finding id as printed by VibeRaven, for example rls_disabled.

name: explain_finding
title: Explain a VibeRaven finding
